import{pose,drawBody}from'./skin.js';
import{geometryScene,rigMath}from'./render.js';
import{box,ellipsoid,bone}from'../opportunity-rig.js';
const{add}=rigMath;
const clamp=x=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x)),smooth=x=>{x=clamp(x);return x*x*(3-2*x)},mix=(a,b,q)=>a+(b-a)*q;
export const refinementDefaults={checkpointRefinementEnabled:true,checkpointRefinementCamera:[0,1,4,0,1,0,1100],checkpointRefinementRedRoot:[-1.11,0,.5],checkpointRefinementCoachRoot:[.85,0,-.1],checkpointRefinementBlueRoot:[-.78,0,.3],checkpointRefinementBlueCoachRoot:[.62,0,-.6],checkpointRefinementBend:1,checkpointRefinementLight:1};
export function refinementPose(t,f={}){f={...refinementDefaults,...f};const blueShot=t>=898+26/30,u=smooth((t-895)/1.05),v=smooth((t-895.9)/2.9),cam=f.checkpointRefinementCamera,camera={eye:cam.slice(0,3),target:cam.slice(3,6),focal:cam[6]};let red,blue,coach;if(!blueShot){red=pose({root:f.checkpointRefinementRedRoot,yaw:Math.PI/2,bend:mix(62,9,u)*f.checkpointRefinementBend,headTilt:mix(13,3,u),seated:true,hipY:mix(.79,.39,u)});coach=pose({root:add(f.checkpointRefinementCoachRoot,[mix(0,.2,v),0,0]),yaw:Math.PI/2,folded:true});}else{camera.eye=[0,.8,3.3];camera.target=[0,1.0,0];camera.focal=1050;blue=pose({root:f.checkpointRefinementBlueRoot,yaw:Math.PI/2+.06*Math.sin((t-899)*2)});coach=pose({root:f.checkpointRefinementBlueCoachRoot,yaw:-Math.PI/2+.2});}return{camera,red,blue,coach,blueShot};}
function tube(scene,points,r,color){for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++)bone(scene,points[i-1],points[i],r,color)}
function chair(scene,root){const tr=([x,y,z])=>add(root,[z,y,-x]);box(scene,tr([0,.37,0]),[.44,.10,.47],'#242124');box(scene,tr([0,.65,-.21]),[.09,.57,.46],'#292629');for(const s of[-1,1]){const points=[];for(let i=0;i<=15;i++){const a=Math.PI*i/15;points.push(tr([s*.26,.35+.25*Math.sin(a),-.22+.46*i/15]));}tube(scene,points,.018,'#8b8c86');for(const z of[-.18,.18])tube(scene,[tr([s*.20,.04,z]),tr([s*.20,.37,z])],.014,'#7e807a');}}
function hat(scene,p,color){const h=p.named.head,axis=rigMath.unit(rigMath.sub(h,p.named.neck));ellipsoid(scene,add(h,rigMath.mul(axis,.135)),[.167,.013,.145],color,axis,6,32);ellipsoid(scene,add(h,rigMath.mul(axis,.21)),[.106,.083,.095],color,axis,10,24);ellipsoid(scene,add(h,rigMath.mul(axis,.15)),[.108,.012,.097],'#aca995',axis,5,24);}
let fog;
function smoke(c,t,strength){fog??=Object.assign(document.createElement('canvas'),{width:240,height:135});const sc=fog.getContext('2d'),im=sc.createImageData(240,135);for(let y=0;y<135;y++)for(let x=0;x<240;x++){const u=y/135,center=65+Math.sin(u*7+t*.45)*18+Math.sin(u*17-t*.36)*8,w=22+u*24,dx=(x-center)/w,n=.5+.22*Math.sin(x*.14+y*.18+t*.6+Math.sin(y*.12)*3)+.15*Math.sin(x*.37-y*.21-t*.4),a=Math.exp(-dx*dx)*Math.sin(Math.PI*u)*Math.max(0,n-.28)*strength,k=(y*240+x)*4;im.data[k]=im.data[k+1]=im.data[k+2]=175;im.data[k+3]=a*170;}sc.putImageData(im,0,0);c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation='screen';c.filter='blur(2px)';c.drawImage(fog,0,-30,960,590);c.restore();}
export function paintRefinement(c,t,input={}){const f={...refinementDefaults,...input},p=refinementPose(t,f);c.save();const bg=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,540);bg.addColorStop(0,p.blueShot?'#07060c':'#160304');bg.addColorStop(1,p.blueShot?'#262137':'#300407');c.fillStyle=bg;c.fillRect(0,0,960,540);if(!p.blueShot&&f.checkpointLayerEdits?.smoke?.visible!==false)smoke(c,t,f.checkpointSmoke??1);const scene=geometryScene(p.camera,{ambient:p.blueShot?.12:.055,power:(p.blueShot?1.3:.55)*f.checkpointRefinementLight,key:p.blueShot?[.6,1,1]:[-.7,.8,.45],rim:[1,.3,-.6],rimColor:p.blueShot?[.65,.7,1]:[1,.05,.015],rimPower:p.blueShot?.6:1.4,specular:p.blueShot?.65:.25});
const visible=id=>f.checkpointLayerEdits?.[id]?.visible!==false;
if(!p.blueShot){if(visible('chair'))chair(scene,add(f.checkpointRefinementRedRoot,[-.03,0,0]));if(visible('red-figure'))drawBody(scene,p.red,f.checkpointRed||'#cb2218');if(visible('desk')){box(scene,[.35,.29,.16],[1.79,.58,.075],'#020202');box(scene,[.35,.59,0],[1.80,.015,.40],'#e8e8e5');}}
else if(visible('blue-figure'))drawBody(scene,p.blue,'#188bd0');if(visible('coach')){drawBody(scene,p.coach,'#eeeedd');hat(scene,p.coach,'#eeeedd');}scene.paint(c);
if(!p.blueShot&&t>898.3&&f.checkpointFocusStrength!==0){/* Source blur is kept as a separate editable overlay in the host. */}
c.restore();return p;}
